content: Today's news includes a declared global health emergency for Ebola outbreaks in DR Congo and Uganda, with cases of a strain with no known vaccine. Fighting continues in Ukraine and Russia, and Mali's forces target rebels with Russian support. The US military boat strikes killed 13, and a hantavirus case appeared in Canada after an outbreak on the MV Hondius. In international matters U.S. tensions rise with Cuba, where Raúl Castro is threatened with indictment, Trump possibly bargaining with Taiwan for China talks and an agreement for Taiwan arms sales will be discussed by the U.S. and China. A leader of Islamic State was reportedly killed in Nigeria, while another accused of masterminding the Rwandan genocide has died. In entertainment, Bulgaria won Eurovision, with the UK in last place, and one Republican senator lost in the Republican primary. A car plowed into pedestrians in Italy, injuring eight.

Today's news includes political instability and conflict, both domestically and internationally. There are leadership challenges in Labour, rival protests and arrests in London, and rioting after a football match in Glasgow. A rescue diver died in the Maldives, and deaths reported in association with hantavirus, Ebola, a freight train collision in Thailand and US military boat strikes. Tensions exist between Taiwan and China, and in relations between the US and Cuba, and between Pakistan and Afghanistan. The army in Mali is targeting rebels, and there's been violence against presidential campaign staffers in Colombia and among settlers and Palestinians. A top Hamas leader was killed in an Israeli strike, and a top Islamic State leader was killed in a U.S.-Nigerian mission. Extreme weather is occurring worldwide and the death of an accused Rwandan genocide mastermind was reported today.

Settler violence continues in Palestinian territory, a Hamas leader was killed in Gaza, and a train accident in Thailand resulted in casualties. Reports surfaced regarding Israeli sexual violence against Palestinians, tension between SPAIN and the USA is on going and China will host Putin after Trump's visit. A hantavirus outbreak occurred on a cruise ship, Iran may be using Proxy groups beyond the Middle East and a bloody week is unfolding in Ukraine and Russia.
